meta.name: account-based-marketing
meta.description: Concentrates marketing and sales effort on a named set of accounts rather than on volume — qualifying whether the model fits your economics at all, building the account list and the buying group inside each, tiering effort against account value, coordinating so the account experiences one campaign rather than several, and measuring account progression instead of leads. Use this to decide whether to run an account-based program, build one, or work out why an existing one produces activity and no pipeline.

copy.tagline: 聚焦高价值客户名单,按价值分层推进营销与销售
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们做B2B营销,想集中资源攻克重点客户而非广撒网
copy.tagline_en: Run account-based marketing by targeting named accounts and measuring progression
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're in B2B marketing/sales and want to focus resources on a named set of high-value accounts

howto.what: Claude 会运用这套 ABM 方法：先协助你判断模式是否符合自身的交易规模、市场规模与销售周期等，适合时再指导你建立账户清单、绘制购买小组、按价值分层、统一营销销售节奏，并衡量账户级进展而非线索量。
howto.when: 当你想决定是否运行 ABM 项目、想新建一套，或要排查已有项目只有活动却不产生管道时。

say.text: 帮我从现有优秀客户里找出共同特征，生成一份初始目标账户清单。
say.note: Claude 会引导你从该类客户出发并添加信号。

say.text: 我的 ABM 项目只有活动但没管道，帮我诊断原因。
say.note: Claude 会检查可能缺失的环节，例如销售接受。

howto.what_en: Claude applies this ABM method: helps you judge fit by deal size, market scope and sales cycle; if it fits, guides building account lists, mapping buying groups, tiering effort by value, aligning marketing and sales cadence, measuring account progression instead of leads.
howto.when_en: When you want to decide whether to run an ABM program, build one from scratch, or troubleshoot why an existing one generates activity but no pipeline.

say_en.text: 50 target accounts, $800k avg deal, 6-month cycle. Does ABM fit?
say_en.note: Claude checks deal size and market limits.

say_en.text: Help me build a target list from patterns in our best existing customers.
say_en.note: Claude suggests starting from best fits and adding signals.

say_en.text: My ABM program has activity but no pipeline. Diagnose why.
say_en.note: Claude checks which root-cause step your program is missing.
